orbitals.orbitals: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE high-quality Star Trek Armada II orbital metal refinery design-review board. User's key requirement: design ONE SHARED CENTRAL FORM, then modify it to suit each faction. Upper header strip shows a neutral unpainted MASTER CORE in a large three-quarter isometric view. Master geometry: compact industrial drum-shaped processing core, a broad low docking collar, four short radial refinery modules on stout arms, two paired downward-facing extraction conduits, small storage silos and visible intake/exhaust machinery. This is a metal orbital industrial processor, not a starbase, not a weapons platform, not a ship. Below the master core, use a clean 3x3 grid of NINE faction adaptations: FEDERATION / BORG / KLINGON, ROMULAN / CARDASSIAN / DOMINION, BAJORAN / BREEN / FERENGI. Keep the SAME recognizable core, docking collar, four-module organization, size and camera angle in every version. Modify armor forms, ribs, pipes, module housings and lights for each faction; this should look like one engineered platform family with real faction adaptations, not nine unrelated silhouettes and not merely nine recolors. Federation: pearl-grey aztec hull panels, Starfleet-red accents, modest cyan windows. Borg: black modular steel, exposed industrial circuit lattice and vivid green nodes, retains the central collar and four arms rather than becoming a cube. Klingon: olive and charcoal plating, angular reinforcement ribs, copper seams, red running lights. Romulan: muted jade armor, emerald feather-like panel layout, elegant swept module covers, green emitters. Cardassian: ochre-bronze industrial armor, dark structural ribs, warm amber apertures, tiny teal lights. Dominion: pale mauve-grey segmented armor, violet bracing, purple-magenta process lights. Bajoran: distinctly light sand/ivory plating, red-copper structure, bronze accents, orange lights and subtle Bajoran markings; visibly different from Cardassian solid bronze. Breen: cool grey and icy teal industrial casing, concealed machinery, restrained cyan lighting, angular Breen technology. Ferengi: copper and warm bronze-gold ovoid industrial shells, curved ribbed module housings, amber lights, pragmatic cargo-handling machinery, strong Ferengi character without oversized currency symbols. Clean navy-black studio backdrop, soft consistent lighting, sharp textured surfaces, readable industrial scale, no planets, no background ships, no laser beams, no combat, no generic space opera scenery. Exact title 'ORBITAL METAL REFINERIES'. Exact subtitle 'One shared core - nine faction adaptations'. Mark small 'Concept artwork - not installed'. Preserve the existing game's functions only by design intent; do not claim the image is a screenshot or ready-to-install textures. Palette and material finish should visually belong with the previous faction HWP concepts, but use the NEW SHARED REFINERY CORE described here rather than HWP geometry.
orbitals.dil: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE polished concept artwork board for a new FERENGI DILITHIUM REFINERY station for a Star Trek Armada II mod. This is a single station design, with one large hero isometric view and two small alternate-view insets plus a compact material palette. The design must be unmistakably Ferengi and visually distinct from a Federation yard, Federation starbase, Cardassian station, and the existing generic metal orbital. Form: compact asymmetrical-yet-balanced industrial docking facility, a broad horseshoe-shaped curved docking collar around a protected freight berth, a low ovoid domed refinery core, two sturdy curved support arms, short finned processing modules at the rear, recessed cyan-lit crystal refinement chambers visible through small inset inspection windows, and copper pipework connecting cargo locks to the core. Match Ferengi starship visual language: warm bronze and copper hull surfaces, segmented lobed curves, burnt-gold armor edges, ribbed organic-mechanical casing and amber navigation lamps. Dilithium cyan is an accent for refinement equipment, not an all-blue hull. Small cyan crystal-shaped illuminated symbol beside a cargo entry, discreet Ferengi insignia. Industrial and functional rather than ornate luxury; no giant floating crystals, no coins, no dollar signs, no planet, no weapons firing, no ships obscuring the station. Keep silhouette readable at the modest size of an RTS mining refinery; believable low-poly mesh-compatible structural volumes with finely painted surface detail. Dark navy studio backdrop and soft cinematic studio lighting consistent with the orbital and HWP concept sets. Exact title 'FERENGI DILITHIUM REFINERY'. Exact subtitle 'Dedicated dilithium processing and freight reception'. Small footer 'Concept artwork - not installed'. Clearly distinguish hull material panels from glowing machinery so the concept can later be translated into game textures. This is design artwork only; do not present it as installed or as a game screenshot. Do not include miners or new research tiers.

yards: Create ONE professional Star Trek Armada II shipyard concept-review board, part1of2. Exact title 'FACTION SHIPYARD FAMILIES I'. Five clearly separated rows labelled FEDERATION, BORG, KLINGON, ROMULAN, CARDASSIAN. Each row shows THREE separate shipyard models in consistent isometric view, columns BASIC YARD, ADVANCED YARD, HERO YARD. Every faction's three facilities must clearly share an engineered visual family, with growing bay count, bracing and service modules for the advanced/hero versions. Shipyards are open industrial assembly docks with empty central ship-clearance volumes and working docking gantries, not closed solid starbases. Federation pearl-grey Starfleet aztec hull panels, cyan lights, red markings, graceful but practical open spacedock frames. Borg black cubic-lattice modular assembly cradles, angular rails and green processing nodes with a completely open construction volume; industrial and asymmetrical extensions at higher tiers. Klingon olive-gunmetal armored forks, red lamps, copper ribs, assertive angular open-bay warship scaffolds. Romulan elegant jade-green bifurcated/swept docking arms, emerald ribs, feather-like panel seams and plasma-green process lights, open bay broad enough for a warbird. Cardassian ochre-bronze open oval scaffold, curved angular grip arms, dark ribs, amber apertures and small teal lights. Higher-tier facilities retain their faction silhouette rather than becoming giant spheres or unrelated monuments. Dark navy studio background, detailed painted-material 3D concepts, consistent gentle lighting and scale across columns. No ships in bays, no combat, no giant lasers, no planets, no humans. Keep all15 facilities and labels clearly legible, comfortable margins. These are actual facility DESIGN concepts for later game-model work, not screenshots or UV maps. Footer 'Concept artwork - not installed'.

Create ONE professional Star Trek Armada II shipyard concept-review board, part2of2. Exact title 'FACTION SHIPYARD FAMILIES II'. Five distinct labelled rows with three panels per row, calm dark navy studio layout, detailed readable isometric painted-material models, consistent lighting. DOMINION row: three related BASIC / ADVANCED / HERO open industrial construction docks, pale mauve-grey armor, dark violet angular bracing and pylons, purple-magenta process lights, broad open freestanding assembly bay. BAJORAN row: BASIC / ADVANCED / HERO related docks with ivory/sand armor, red copper and bronze framework, orange guidance lamps, subtle Bajoran crest pattern; sweeping open horseshoe or wishbone construction frames with practical gantries; clearly not Cardassian all-bronze yards. BREEN row: ONE SINGLE COMBINED YARD design shown in three angles labelled ISOMETRIC / FRONT / REAR; grey/icy teal enclosed-sided industrial dock with wide open construction aperture, cyan indicators, angular Breen architecture. Do not invent Breen tiered facilities: it is the same single model viewed three ways. FERENGI row: first panel COMBAT YARD with lobed bronze/copper curved assembly cradle; second panel SERVICE YARD, related bronze ovoid industrial dock with freight locks and amber lights, distinct supporting-service geometry; third panel SHARED MATERIAL DETAIL close-up. There are only two Ferengi yard types, not three tiers. Ferengi facilities match a copper/bronze horseshoe dilithium refinery family, no Federation spacedock shapes, no giant coins or currency signs. SPECIES8472 row: first panel FLUIDIC GATE, a living alien portal-like production organism; second panel ADVANCED HATCHERY, related larger organic ribbed nursery structure with open brood chamber; third panel LIVING MATERIAL DETAIL close-up. Biology grown from fluidic membranes, ribbed living carapace, bone/ochre outer tissue and purple/green luminous organic conduits; not metallic starbases, not Borg circuitry. Keep all15 panels distinct and labels legible. Production volumes open and unobstructed. No background planets, no fleets, no battles, no beams firing, no people. Footer 'Concept artwork - not installed'.
materials: Create ONE square production-ready diffuse texture atlas for low-poly Star Trek Armada II structures, exactly a 4 by 4 grid of equally sized texture cells with NO GAPS, NO BORDERS, NO LABELS, NO TEXT, NO ICONS and no objects or perspective. Each cell is a flat orthographic painted hull-material texture with fine sci-fi panel seams, convincing metal roughness and restrained small illuminated strips, suitable to apply directly to surfaces using UV coordinates. IMPORTANT do not render ships or stations: this image itself is a flat material map. All16 cells fill the square edge to edge, aligned precisely in four equal rows and four equal columns. Row1 left to right: 1 Starfleet pearl-grey aztec hull plating with a few tiny cyan lights and restrained red detail; 2 Borg very dark charcoal industrial circuitry and micro-greebles with thin green light channels; 3 Klingon olive/gunmetal angled armored plates with copper seams and tiny red lights; 4 Romulan jade and dark emerald hull panels with subtle feather-like engraved seams and green luminous insets. Row2: 1 Cardassian ochre-bronze plates with dark ribs and amber lights; 2 Dominion pale mauve and violet segmented industrial armor with thin magenta process lights; 3 Bajoran light sand/ivory armor panels over copper-red ribs and warm orange lights, clearly lighter than Cardassian; 4 Breen cold blue-grey and icy teal industrial plates with cyan lamps. Row3: 1 Ferengi warm copper and bronze-gold curved plate seams, ribbed industrial details, amber lighting with a few tiny cyan crystal-processing lamps; 2 Species8472 living ochre/bone carapace and ribbed organic tissue with purple and green bioluminescent capillaries, not metal; 3 nearly black neutral gunmetal open lattice and dark recessed machinery, no coloured lights; 4 silver steel piping, conduits and grated industrial vents. Row4: 1 cyan illuminated glass and dark machinery, not featureless glow; 2 green illuminated circuitry and dark machinery; 3 purple illuminated conduits and dark machinery; 4 amber illuminated conduits and dark machinery. Match the approved faction concept palettes. Fine surface detail still readable after a cell is reduced to256pixels. No cast shadows across cells, no textural cross-contamination between cells, no weapons, no logos, no extra outer margin. A single unified game texture asset, not a presentation board.
